metric_note: Points-focused. Every number is a per-player paired difference (condition A minus condition B), summarised across players. pts and minutes are per-game averages; per36 = 36 x sum(pts) / sum(minutes) in each condition.

definitions.games: Regular season only (game_id 002). NBA Cup group and knockout games count (they are 002); Cup final (006), playoffs, play-in excluded. Player-games with minutes > 0 only.
definitions.home_away: Home = matchup 'vs.', away = '@'. Neutral-site games (isNeutral in BoxScoreSummaryV3: global games and Cup semifinals in Las Vegas) are excluded from home/away.
definitions.b2b_2nd: Team played the previous calendar day.
definitions.b2b_1st: Team plays the next calendar day and did not play the previous day.
definitions.rested: Team had 1+ days off before the game and does not play the next day. Season openers excluded.
definitions.rest_basis: Team schedule dates (the team the player played for in that game). 2025-26 team dates include the Cup final (006) as a played date; 2026-27 uses the full official schedule so cutoff-night games know whether a game follows the next day.
definitions.position: Primary (first-listed) position from that season's CommonTeamRoster (2025-26 fallback: PlayerIndex 2025-26): G-F -> G, F-C -> F, C-F -> C.
definitions.age: Age on Feb 1 of the season from birth date (CommonTeamRoster BIRTH_DATE; CommonPlayerInfo BIRTHDATE for players on neither roster pull). Buckets: <=23, 24-27, 28-31, 32+.
definitions.experience: CommonTeamRoster EXP for that season ('R' = 0). Buckets: rookie, 1-3, 4-7, 8+.
definitions.scorer_tier: Rank by season PPG (minutes>0 games) among players with >= 20 games (2025-26) / >= 4 games (2026-27): top_10, 11_25, 26_50, 51_100; 'rest' = everyone else, including players under the games threshold.
definitions.combined: Units are player-seasons (a player can contribute one unit per season, each with that season's segments). p-value from the paired t-test over units; CI from a bootstrap that resamples players (clusters).
definitions.stats: Mean and median of per-player differences; two-sided one-sample (paired) t-test vs 0; percentile bootstrap 95% CI of the mean, 10000 resamples, seed 20261104.
definitions.fields: n_players, n_units, games_a / games_b (player-games in condition A / B among qualifying units), mean_a / mean_b (average of per-player condition means), small_n = fewer than 20 units.

caveats: 2026-27 is a very small sample (games through 2026-11-02, ~6-8 per team); treat its numbers as provisional.
Observational: B2B and venue are not randomised; coaches rest players around B2Bs (absent players are not in the data, which can bias toward healthier players).
Many comparisons are reported; expect some p < 0.05 by chance.

sources.box_scores: stats.nba.com PlayerGameLogs (curated; 2026-27 incl. official pts/min corrections, hoopstats 88a2676)
